text: Pressing pushes out more whey than in soft cheese, leaving 54–69 % moisture in the fat-free mass (Codex 'firm/semi-hard'), so the cheese can be sliced. Weeks to months of ripening then build flavour.

steps.note: The cheese is pressed in 3–10 steps, at about 50–450 g/cm².
The cheese is put into brine at 10–16 °C.
The cheese is ripened for weeks to months, by type, and Gouda-type cheese is ripened at 12–15 °C and 75–80 % humidity.
